summary: PDRM V2 workflow testing complete. Auto/Manual toggle works correctly with proper color changes (green=AUTO, yellow=MANUAL). Sidebar messages change based on mode. Toggle state persists to localStorage. Opening Surgeon View does NOT create PDRM entries until highlight or page change. Page extraction shows 'Extracting key facts...' indicator. PDRM entries have structured P/D/R/M fields.

ui_bugs.issue: PDF processing error shown: 'Error: PDF processing failed: Error processing PDF file. The PDF viewer will still work for viewing.'

critical_code_review_comments: Auto/Manual toggle correctly uses bg-green-600 for AUTO and bg-yellow-600 for MANUAL
Toggle state persists via Zustand persist middleware to localStorage key 'pdrm-storage-v2'
PDRM sidebar shows correct message based on mode: 'auto-extract PDRM' vs 'create draft PDRM'
Page extraction indicator shows 'Extracting key facts from page X...' with animation
PDRM entries display structured P/D/R/M fields (not summaries) with color-coded labels
Opening Surgeon View does NOT auto-create PDRM entries - count stays at 0
context_for_next_testing_agent: PDRM V2 workflow verified. Sample PDF has minimal text so page extraction returns empty. To test highlight-based PDRM creation, need a PDF with more text content.
